pool.title: Infinity Pool
pool.description: Our rooftop infinity pool is the crown jewel of Batumi Boutique Hotel. Stretching 25 meters with an infinity edge that seemingly merges with the Black Sea, this architectural masterpiece offers an unparalleled swimming experience. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls provide 180-degree panoramic views while you swim. The heated water maintains a perfect 28°C year-round, making it comfortable in any season. Underwater LED lighting creates a magical ambiance for evening swims.

about.meetThePeople: Meet the People Behind the Experience
about.heroSubtitle: A masterpiece of modern architecture on Georgia's stunning Black Sea coast
about.story1: Grand Boutique Hotel was born from a dream to create something extraordinary on the shores of the Black Sea. Its contemporary 2026 architecture blends refined elegance with the natural beauty of Georgia's coast.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How {hotel} handles guest information for reservations, stays, and hotel services.
privacy.collectBody1: We collect information that guests provide directly when making a reservation, checking in, contacting the concierge team, or using hotel services.
privacy.collectBody2: This may include contact details, identification details required by law, payment and billing information, stay preferences, and special requests.
privacy.useBody1: Personal data is used to process reservations, provide tailored service, process secure payments, manage required guest records, and support a seamless experience at {hotel}.
privacy.useBody2: We may send essential booking confirmations, pre-arrival information, and service updates related to a guest stay.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell personal data. We only share necessary information with trusted providers such as payment processors, booking systems, and operational partners when needed to provide hotel services.
privacy.securityBody: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or loss.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or requests, contact {email}.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Reservation, stay, and guest service terms for {hotel}.
terms.metadataDescription: Terms and conditions for reservations, stays, and guest services at {hotel}.
terms.reservationsBody1: All reservations are subject to availability. To secure your booking, a valid credit card or approved payment method may be required. By providing payment details, you authorize {hotel} to charge the applicable deposit, pre-authorization, or full stay amount according to the selected rate.
terms.reservationsBody2: Rates may be quoted in GEL or USD and may include taxes or service charges depending on the booking channel and rate plan.
terms.checkInBody1: Check-in is available from 15:00. Check-out is until 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may incur an additional fee.
terms.checkInBody2: A valid government-issued photo ID or passport is required at check-in for each registered guest where required by law.
terms.cancellationBody: Standard reservations may be cancelled or modified without penalty up to 48 hours before scheduled arrival unless a stricter rate condition applies. Late cancellations, no-shows, non-refundable rates, promotional bookings, and group reservations may be charged according to the confirmed booking terms.
terms.responsibilitiesBody1: Guests are responsible for respecting hotel property, other guests, and local laws. The hotel may charge for damage to rooms, furnishings, equipment, or facilities caused during a stay.
terms.responsibilitiesBody2: Smoking policies, quiet hours, pet policies, event use, and additional guest rules may be confirmed separately by the hotel team.
terms.liabilityBody: The hotel is not responsible for loss, damage, or theft of personal property except where required by applicable Georgian law. Guests are encouraged to use the in-room safe for valuables.
terms.contactBody: For reservation questions or clarification of these terms, contact {email} or {phone}.
